A man's sexual complex leads to a loss of confidence not only when dating a partner, but also at work and at home. By losing your positivity, you may end up missing out on valuable opportunities in your work and private life.
At Norris Clinic, we offer a men's menu to help alleviate and eliminate sexual complexes for men who find it difficult to talk to others. Please feel free to contact us.

mens formation

What is phimosis surgery?

This is a surgical procedure in which the foreskin of the penis is incised or removed to expose the glans if phimosis is causing problems in sexual activity or urination. It is mainly performed as a treatment for true phimosis and cantonal phimosis, but many people with pseudophimosis are also treated for the purpose of improving hygiene and appearance. The procedure uses anesthesia and can be done on the same day.

Surgical method Features Strengths
mechanical method How to remove excess foreskin using a device called a clamp
Some clinics use laser scalpels for removal.

Surgery can be performed in a short time
Less bleeding during and after surgery
Just below the glans method How to measure the length of the excess foreskin and remove and suture the excess foreskin Surgery scars are less noticeable
Natural finish
If this is the case, please contact our hospital.
  • Those with true phimosis or cantonal phimosis
  • Are concerned about hygiene
  • Those who suffer from premature ejaculation
  • Those who feel pain due to foreskin abrasion
  • People who have a complex about their appearance
Features of phimosis surgery at our hospital
Price includes anesthesia thread and surgery fee

For phimosis surgery at our hospital, the price includes anesthesia threads and surgery fees.

The treatment will be performed by a urology specialist or instructor.

The director of our hospital is a urologist with extensive experience in general hospitals and clinics.
We utilize our knowledge of anatomy, urinary surgery, and plastic surgery to provide safe surgeries that reduce pain and the risk of complications.

We do not offer unnecessary upsells.

We do not offer unnecessary upsells.
We will decide the details of the treatment in consultation with the patient, so please feel free to contact us first.

Treatments and surgeries are available even on Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays.

We provide medical treatment not only on weekdays from Wednesday to Friday, but also on Saturdays and Sundays.
No need to worry if you are busy on weekdays.
The clinic hours are from 10:30 to 19:00 on weekdays and Saturdays and Sundays.

Phimosis surgery process

1Inquiries/Reservations

First, please make a reservation for counseling by phone or online.

2Free unselling

Counseling and examinations are conducted in a completely private room.
Please feel free to let us know your concerns and wishes.

3treatment

The surgery is performed carefully to ensure that the anesthesia is effective and that no scars remain.

4Aftercare

If you have any problems after your treatment, we will be happy to assist you.

Risks and side effects of phimosis surgery (mechanical method/directly below the glans method)

There is a possibility of bleeding, infection, scars, differences in the left and right results, changes in sensation, and reoperation.

pipe cut

Officially, it is called ``vas ligation''. By cutting the vas deferens, the passage of sperm from the testicles is blocked and pregnancy cannot occur.
There are various methods of contraception, but the most reliable method currently is vasectomy. Although it is considered rare in Japan, it is commonly practiced in other countries.
This is mainly for people who have decided not to have children or who have been determined by a doctor that contraception is necessary.

Risks and side effects of pipe cutting

Mild swelling of the scrotum, internal bleeding, sperm granuloma, infection, etc.

Removal of warts/penile papules (bumps on the glans/penis)

Removes bumps that form on the glans and penis.
Causes of bumps include genital warts and pearly papules. These characteristics include warts on the glans neck and other areas. When genital warts become severe, the warts harden and become cauliflower-shaped.
Condylomata are sexually transmitted diseases and must be removed. There is no need for treatment for penile papules, but if you are concerned about them, you can have surgery to remove them.
The treatment method involves removing the warts one by one using electric scalpel.

Risks and side effects of removing warts/penile papules (bulges on the glans/penis)

Pain, irritation, scarring, possibility of recurrence, etc.

glans enlargement

This treatment (day surgery) is suitable for people who are concerned about the size of their glans penis, such as being embarrassed to be seen in hot springs or saunas, having less hardness and elasticity than when they were younger, or being worried about whether or not they are able to satisfy their partner.
The glans can be enlarged by injecting a drug, and the treatment takes 10 to 15 minutes.
For about 2 weeks after surgery, it is necessary to monitor the bleeding and restrict sexual activity and masturbation.
In 3 to 4 weeks, the injection scars will almost disappear and your movements will no longer be restricted.

Risks and side effects of glans enlargement

Temporary discoloration and swelling have been reported, and infection and lumps are rare when the injection is performed on the penis or glans.

silicone ball removal

Silicone ball removal is a surgical procedure in which a silicone ball inserted under the skin of the penis is removed at the patient's request. First, during a medical examination, we check the location, number, size, and ease of movement of the inserted implants, and evaluate the presence of skin inflammation, infection, exposure, scarring, and adhesion with surrounding tissue. Depending on the condition, the positional relationship between the ball and the surrounding tissue may be confirmed using ultrasound tests.

Usually local anesthesia is given and a small incision is made in the skin near the silicone ball or along the scar from where it was inserted. After carefully separating the tissue so as not to damage surrounding blood vessels, nerves, and the corpus cavernosum, the ball is removed, the bleeding is stopped, the wound is cleaned, and the wound is sutured. If multiple balls are involved, multiple incisions may be made depending on the location of each ball.

If the implant has been in place for a long time, or if there is infection, exposure, strong adhesions, or skin damage, the incision may be wider or scar tissue or damaged tissue may be removed. After the surgery, we will monitor the progress while checking the condition of the wound. You may be asked to refrain from sexual intercourse, masturbation, strenuous exercise, and drinking alcohol until the wound has stabilized. Even after removal, scarring, skin irregularities, hardness, and deformity may remain, and the appearance and sensation may not necessarily return to the same as before insertion.

Risks and side effects of glans enlargement

After surgery, pain, swelling, redness, internal bleeding, hemorrhage, and hematoma may occur. In addition, there is a possibility of infection, opening of the wound, delayed healing of the wound, noticeable scarring, pigmentation, and unevenness, left-right disparity, and hardness of the skin.
If the silicone ball is strongly adhered to the surrounding tissue, it may not be possible to remove all of it, or the incision may become larger. In rare cases, it may damage blood vessels, nerves, corpus cavernosum, urethra, etc., resulting in decreased sensation/sensitivity, chronic pain, urinary problems, deformed/curved/shortened penis, and effects on erectile function.

 

ED treatment

ED (erectile dysfunction) is a condition where the penis is unable to get or maintain an erection due to various reasons, making it impossible to have satisfactory sexual intercourse.
ED treatment focuses on oral administration of ED drugs that help with erections.

Do you have any problems like this?

  • Erections are weaker than before
  • inability to maintain an erection, difficulty
  • Even if I get an erection, it's not hard enough
  • Erection weakens after insertion
  • Although I have a sexual desire and am excited, I cannot achieve a sufficient erection.
  • Unable to have satisfying sexual intercourse due to insufficient erection

Four types of ED and treatment methods

organic ED

ED is caused by obvious causes such as disease or injury, such as arteriosclerosis or damage to blood vessels or nerves.
In addition to treating the underlying illness or injury, we will use ED medication.

Psychogenic ED

ED is caused by psychological problems such as low self-confidence, pressure from past trauma, and stress.
We will clarify the content of the pressure and stress and use ED treatment drugs while working to reduce it. The sense of security that you are safe because you are using ED treatment drugs also contributes to resolving ED.

mixed ED

ED is a mixture of organic ED and psychogenic ED.
We use ED treatment drugs while providing total care that approaches each cause.

drug-induced ED

ED occurs as a side effect of the medications you are currently using.
You can expect improvement with ED treatment drugs, but please never use them together at your own discretion. Be sure to tell your doctor about any medications you are currently taking.

STD test

At Norris Clinic, we conduct tests for sexually transmitted diseases. A sexually transmitted disease is a disease that is transmitted through sexual activity. In other words, it includes not only sex but also sexual contact through mucous membranes, such as oral sex.
We recommend STD testing for both men and women, not only when you are concerned about symptoms, but also when you find out your partner has a STD, when you start a new relationship, or before getting married.
Also, depending on the diseaseInsurance medical treatmentbecomes possible.

[Blood test] HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, herpes

HIV

Checks for the presence of antibodies against the HIV virus.
Results will be available in about 2 days.

syphilis

Check for the presence of Treponema pallidum infection.
Results will be visible within 1 to 2 days.

Hepatitis B/Hepatitis C

Check for infection with hepatitis B virus and hepatitis C virus.
Results will be visible within 1 to 4 days.

herpes

Check for herpes virus infection.
Results can be seen in 3 to 7 days using the CF method and 8 to 15 days using the NT method.
The NT method has better sensitivity, but as mentioned above, it takes a little longer to make a determination.

[Urethral/vaginal secretion test] Gonorrhea/Chlamydia

gonorrhea

Genetic analysis will be performed using Neisseria gonorrhoeae PCR.
Results will be available in 2 to 4 days.

chlamydia

Genetic analysis using chlamydia PCR will be performed.
Results will be available in 2 to 4 days.
